name: promptfill
description: Prompt-driven form filling: an embeddable widget (npm), a Chrome extension, and the API server behind them.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @promptfill/core && npm run build -w @promptfill/widget && npm run build -w @promptfill/server && npm run build -w @promptfill/extension && npm run build -w @promptfill/demo
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/widget && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p apps/extension && tsc -p apps/demo
